description: Headlamp beams (game/scripts/headlights.gd): one SpotLight3D per headlamp cluster of the car rig's lights.head materials. Visual tuning [AS], Godot units (energy, metres, degrees). lights_per_car 1 merges both lamps into one spot (half the GPU passes, see the cost note in headlights.gd). Shadows off: a shadowed spot renders a shadow map every frame.
